video.title: Schema Version, VersionedSchema & SchemaMigrationPlan | Day 219
video.description:
Learn to explain how SwiftData updates saved data when your models change: Schema Version, VersionedSchema & SchemaMigrationPlan, with real code, a quiz at the end and each example read twice (normal, then slow).

Today's terms
Schema Version - A version number that marks one shape of your saved data, such as 1.0.0 or 2.0.0.
VersionedSchema - A protocol for one numbered version of your data shape, so SwiftData can compare the old and the new.
SchemaMigrationPlan - A plan that lists all schema versions and the steps that move saved data from one to the next.

Quiz at the end - write your answers in the comments, then watch again to check.

landscape.description:
Explain Schema Version, VersionedSchema & SchemaMigrationPlan in iOS by listening to a real code chat between two iOS devs.
Schema Version, VersionedSchema, SchemaMigrationPlan 표현을 영어 대화로 익혀요.

Schema Version - A version number that marks one shape of your saved data, such as 1.0.0 or 2.0.0.
한국어: Schema Version: 1.0.0이나 2.0.0처럼 저장 데이터의 한 가지 모양을 나타내는 버전 번호

VersionedSchema - A protocol for one numbered version of your data shape, so SwiftData can compare the old and the new.
한국어: VersionedSchema: SwiftData가 이전 모양과 새 모양을 비교할 수 있게 번호가 붙은 데이터 모양 하나를 나타내는 프로토콜

SchemaMigrationPlan - A plan that lists all schema versions and the steps that move saved data from one to the next.
한국어: SchemaMigrationPlan: 모든 스키마 버전과 저장 데이터를 한 버전에서 다음으로 옮기는 단계를 나열한 계획

landscape.hook: Can you explain Schema Version, VersionedSchema and SchemaMigrationPlan in English?

dialogue.title: Version two is coming

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Jake, we add a field to `Note` in the next release. Is that safe?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Old data must move to the new shape. SwiftData needs to know both versions.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: How do I name a version?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: With a schema version, like `v` in our code. It is a number such as 2.0.0.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: And where do I put the models for each version?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: In a type that conforms to VersionedSchema. Make one for each release.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Do I need a VersionedSchema for the very first release too?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes. It is your starting point, so keep it.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: How does SwiftData connect the versions?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: With a SchemaMigrationPlan. It lists the schemas and the stages between them.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: In our code, `Plan` is that SchemaMigrationPlan.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Right. Keep every schema version in the plan, in order.
Give the new models schema version 2.0.0.
